description: Describes MXL Receiver transport parameters, per AMWA BCP-007-03 (NMOS With MXL). The constraints in this schema are minimum constraints, but may be further constrained at the constraints endpoint.
title: MXL Receiver Transport Parameters

mxl_domain_id.description: MXL domain this receiver subscribes to. Deviation from BCP-007-03: accepts any string, not just a UUID resolved via a domain_def.json - this DreamCatcher deployment uses the literal mxl-fabrics-proxy domain path (e.g. /dev/shm/mxl) directly.

mxl_flow_id.description: MXL flow id (uuid) this receiver subscribes to
